name: Charges Per Type 6
definition: Provides a detailed breakdown of the charges per type of charges.

ChargesIdentification.name: Charges Identification
ChargesIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the charges information for reconciliation purpose.||Usage: this identification shall be used as the end-to-end identification in the resulting message for the payment of the charges, to allow for automated reconciliation.

TotalChargesPerChargeType.name: Total Charges Per Charge Type
TotalChargesPerChargeType.definition: Total charges claimed through for the specified charge type.

ChargesAccountAgent.name: Charges Account Agent
ChargesAccountAgent.definition: Agent that services the charges account.||Usage: this element should be used where the charge being claimed does not relate to the processing of a payment transaction e.g. it relates to an investigation or other process. This identifies the agent that services the account from which charges are to be settled from.

ChargesAccountAgentAccount.name: Charges Account Agent Account
ChargesAccountAgentAccount.definition: Account of the agent that services the charges account.||Usage: this element should be used where the charge being claimed does not relate to the processing of a payment transaction e.g. it relates to an investigation or other process. This identifies the account from which charges are to be settled from.

Record.name: Record
Record.definition: Itemised charges record per charges type.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the reason for the charges.

ChargesAccountAgent2Rule.definition: When Record/ChargesAccountAgent is present or Record/ChargesAccountAgentAccount is present then ChargesAccountAgent must be absent and ChargesAccountAgentAccount must be absent.

ChargesAccountAgentRule.definition: When ChargesAccountAgent is present or ChargesAccountAgentAccount is present then  Record/ChargesAccountAgent must be absent and Record/ChargesAccountAgentAccount must be absent.
